messages:
Ellen (PM): Heads-up: Big customer request: BYOK for hosted + private, 6-7yr audit retention, and auditor-friendly export packages. Need quick scoping for prioritization.

Noah (Sales): Deal matter. They want per-tenant retention tiers and an API to trigger exports. Pricing must be predictable.

Sam (Security): Security asks: preserve wrapped DEKs per rotation, produce signed export manifests (Merkle root or hash chain). If they insist on KMS-tied signatures, that's enterprise-only.

Ivy (Eng): MVP plan: CMEK support, tenant retention settings (90d/2yr/5yr/7yr), daily compressed log chunks, export job that bundles logs + manifest + Redwood-sig. Estimate 6-8w dev + infra.

Riley (Legal): Exports must include chain-of-custody: requester, approver, hash list, signer identity, and timestamp. 5 business days SLA for standard exports sounds fine. Need legal-hold flow.

Ellen (PM): Draft acceptance criteria: 1) CMEK across hosted/dedicated, 2) tenant retention up to 7yr, 3) exportable evidence package with signed manifest, 4) audit trail + legal-hold, 5) cost/pricing proposal for archival.

Noah (Sales): We'll propose enterprise surcharge for >2yr and expedited export fee. I'll collect affected pipeline.

Ivy (Eng): Action: prototype export runner + storage cost estimate (due EOW).

Sam (Security): Action: security design for wrapped DEKs + signed manifests (due EOW).

Riley (Legal): Action: export artifact checklist + SLA wording (due Tue).

infra-bot: Created ticket PROD-6001 "BYOK + multi-year retention scoping" assigned to @Ivy, @Sam, @Ellen. Due in 7 days.

Ellen (PM): Thanks everyone — reconvene after deliverables.
